items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: Old Man Valto, he played violin there for a long time. ... Do you know the old man?

ctx.x: Yeah, it had Joe Oliver and Old Man Valto. Who else was there? Old Man Valto was there for a while, and then, let me see, there was, Jimmy Pallow was there for a while. You heard talking about Jimmy Pallow? Did you hear Jimmy Pallow? He was a violinist, Jimmy Pallow was, you know. He was there for a while. Old Man Valto, he played violin there for a long time. Will Elfrey, tell him Will Elfrey. I know him. Do you know Will Elfrey? I don't mean the son.
Do you know the old man?
